summary: ✔ Test run with 62 tests in 4 suites passed after 1.063 seconds.

checks.name: New document preserves current edits
checks.detail: New model is clean; switching restores original crop, zoom and pan without replacing the source.

checks.name: Independent document Undo
checks.detail: Undo/Redo belongs to the selected document; another editor's history remains clean.

checks.name: Close selects surviving document
checks.detail: Closing releases the old editor source and selects the surviving model.

checks.name: Saved recent reopens flattened
checks.detail: Actual PNG encoded/decoded at 800 by 1000; reopening has no vectors, dirty state or Undo history.

checks.name: Discarded recent restores saved pixels
checks.detail: Discarding newer edits retains the last saved flattened image.

checks.name: Clear Recents preserves open images
checks.detail: Recent ownership is removed while the other open document retains its immutable source.

checks.name: Recent-copy failure cannot trap close
checks.detail: A deliberately removed synthetic saved output yields a visible warning and closes without a broken Recent.

checks.name: Cancelled close preserves document
checks.detail: A cancelled actual close task leaves the source/model open and creates no Recent.

checks.name: Stale save cannot affect another document
checks.detail: Wrong identity or changed edit snapshot cannot mark another document saved or retain an unrelated output.

checks.name: Clear Recents removes private copies
checks.detail: Actual owned image file exists while recent, then its source and private file release on Clear Recents.

checks.name: Workspace resource limits preserve documents
checks.detail: Injected count and storage limits reject imports without evicting open edits or adding rows.

checks.name: Inspector crop undo/redo
checks.detail: Three typed digits commit one source-pixel edit; Undo restores the original and Redo restores 800 px.

checks.name: Crop preset undo/redo
checks.detail: Crop bounds and preset restore together.

checks.name: Inspector annotation undo/delete
checks.detail: A fractionally positioned rectangle resized by typed digits displays 300 px; Undo restores the entire original object. Dimension editing and deletion each commit one reversible operation.

checks.name: Inspector numeric bounds
checks.detail: Int minimum/maximum dimensions remain inside the source; nonfinite and extreme display values convert safely.

checks.name: Nondestructive quarter-turn and one-step Undo Redo
checks.detail: Rotation changes value state only; crop/source ownership is stable and the viewport fits.

checks.name: Rotated exact crop dimensions and native Copy
checks.detail: Visible width/height map back to bounded source pixels; actual system image decodes at 250 by 400.

checks.name: Rotated preset follows output axes
checks.detail: The 16:9 preset follows the visible/exported orientation.

checks.name: Accessible annotation insertion and Undo
checks.detail: Every supported non-freehand object is inserted in source pixels at the crop center, remains selected/editable, preserves zoom/pan and commits one Undo/Redo operation.

checks.name: Accessible annotation style and text editing
checks.detail: Insertion reuses the current retained style and last shape, requests native text editing for text, and does not invent a freehand path.

checks.name: Contextual annotation kind precedence
checks.detail: The selected object owns inspector controls; an active annotation tool takes precedence over the remembered shape when nothing is selected.

checks.name: Prepared text defaults and creation Undo
checks.detail: Text content, font, traits, alignment and color prepared before insertion create the retained text object without irrelevant shape fill; insertion remains one reversible edit.

checks.name: Source-pixel pixelation size and inspector Undo
checks.detail: Pixelation reports the renderer's 16-pixel minimum and maps a 128-pixel target to its retained rendering parameter. Multiple live changes undo together; non-finite input is rejected.

checks.name: Persistent inspector gesture Undo boundaries
checks.detail: Style, canvas movement and later style edits undo separately while the inspector stays visible. Multiple style changes after Undo or Redo still form one operation; mid-gesture callbacks do not absorb geometry, and Pan adds no edit.

checks.name: Selection reveal preserves document and history
checks.detail: Show Selection requests canvas-owned recentering without modifying source edits or adding Undo; actual viewport movement is verified by native canvas interaction separately.

checks.name: Direct native share snapshot bytes
checks.detail: The real Transferable produces a single decoded 800×600 PNG with the flattened green annotation; original and private source bytes remain unchanged. No recipient behavior is inferred.

checks.name: Document saved baseline
checks.detail: Dirty state follows the initial/last durable snapshot, including Undo away from or back to that snapshot.

checks.name: Stale save and close ownership
checks.detail: Newer edits and a closed source reject stale save completions; close clears document state and history.

checks.name: Failed and cancelled replacement
checks.detail: Actual failed file decoding and a cancelled import preserve the previous source, edits and dirty state.

checks.name: Live typography undo transaction
checks.detail: Text editing is requested on creation; content and typography update as one reversible edit. Font displays are safely bounded independently of image dimensions.

checks.name: Annotation arrangement and mode preservation
checks.detail: Duplicates retain typography, front/back ordering changes retained objects, and mode switching preserves objects and viewport.

checks.name: PNG explicit image paste
checks.detail: An actual NSItemProvider imports unchanged encoded bytes through the shared protected source pipeline and resets the editing baseline.

checks.name: JPEG explicit image paste
checks.detail: An actual NSItemProvider imports unchanged encoded bytes through the shared protected source pipeline and resets the editing baseline.

checks.name: Invalid image paste preserves document
checks.detail: Empty, text-only and malformed encoded providers report errors while preserving the current source, crop, dirty state and Undo availability.

checks.name: Cancelled image paste preserves document
checks.detail: Cancelling an in-flight provider propagates to its Progress, preserves source/edit/history and ignores a delayed completion.

checks.name: Closed document rejects stale image paste
checks.detail: Closing while a provider loads prevents its eventual successful source from reopening or changing the document.

checks.name: Shared asynchronous file import
checks.detail: The native model imports through the shared worker, installs an immutable full-resolution source and resets the saved/history baseline.

checks.name: Photo transfer ownership before decoding
checks.detail: Dropping a real ImportedPhoto before decoding removes its private copy; cancelled shared-worker decoding throws cancellation without accepting a source.

checks.name: PNG full-resolution export
checks.detail: Decoded 800 × 600 image; 41344 bytes.

checks.name: PNG clipboard round-trip
checks.detail: Read and decoded the actual system pasteboard data and standard UIImage representation.

checks.name: JPEG full-resolution export
checks.detail: Decoded 800 × 600 image; 57540 bytes.

checks.name: JPEG clipboard round-trip
checks.detail: Read and decoded the actual system pasteboard data and standard UIImage representation.

initial_compile.reason: Throwing boolean condition syntax corrected before native execution.

physical.limitation: Device reports passcode required; normal launch and process verification were not attempted through the passcode gate.

source_identity: Final close-path native, services, signed and applied App/Core hashes agree. The nine-case run preceded only close recovery and announcement ownership changes.
runtime_observation: UIKit emitted a portal-view hosting warning during native numeric selection; actual edit/Undo/export passed. No app-owned hosting/view-controller representable found. Hardware acceptance remains separate.
limits: Recents are session/window-only, not durable document history.
Source/preview retention bounds do not certify peak export memory or hardware file protection.
Passing native accessibility audits do not certify physical assistive technology or gaze/hand/focus.
Probe compilation does not verify capture on hardware.
